title: Ayutthaya kingdom
summary: Ayutthaya developed as a Siamese capital on an island formed by rivers connected to the sea. Its location supported commerce and diplomacy while shaping the city’s protection from floods and attack.

claims.text: Ayutthaya developed as a Siamese capital on an island formed by rivers connected to the sea. Its location supported commerce and diplomacy while shaping the city’s protection from floods and attack.
The heritage description qualifies the foundation as approximately 1350.
River geography helps explain the capital’s regional and overseas connections. The foundation year marks a political milestone, not the beginning of all human activity in the area.
